content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati) for its R&D projects based in Assam.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names available in IIT Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: The available positions under this notification are Assistant Project Engineer and Junior Research Fellow (JRF) with a total of 3 vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for IIT Guwahati positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 07-10-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Project Engineer?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech. in Electronics or Mechanical or closely related discipline, or M.Sc. in Electronics with relevant R&D or industrial experience.

faq.question: Q5. What salary will be provided for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the JRF position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 23198 including basic pay, HRA, and medical allowances.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification, making the application process free of cost for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of applications followed by an in-person interview scheduled to be conducted on 09-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the IIT Guwahati JRF vacancy?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official Recruitment Portal of the Research & Development Cell at IIT Guwahati using the provided link.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for the Assistant Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: The Assistant Project Engineer receives a total monthly salary package of Rs. 43730 which comprises basic pay, HRA, and medical benefits.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links for the official notification PDF, online application portal, and the official website in the Important Links section above.
